speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: They sent us off the loom. I came by the wall. My cap was in my hand before I reached the yard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Up. The lumber garret over Master Shakespeare's chamber. A jug and a pot. Do not stand where the close can count you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I'll take the jug. The pot is by the stair. Give me a moment and the room is a room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do not speak yet. Your hand on the book. You first.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: If any ask, the back room is let to a man from Norwich. From Norwich. Say it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Verbeke is from Norwich tonight, if anybody asks. He has always had a Norwich face.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From Norwich.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: From Norwich, mistress. I can say it. I will not add a street to it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will not add anything. A man from Norwich. That is the sentence. Gillis.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Norwich. Yes. I am from Norwich. I say it so. Norwich.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And if they ask his trade?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: They will not have a trade from this house. They will have the sentence, or they will have the door. Mark me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The garret is ready. A jug and a pot, as you said. There is no one on the stair.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will go up. I will not tell Ghent in a doorway.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Dutch and French, the lane said, at noon. This house has one answer, and the answer is not a story about a loom.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One answer. I will not improve it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I change the latch?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the latch as it always is. A house that changes its habits is a house with a tale. We are a dull house. Be dull.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not cast tomorrow. I keep the house. If anyone asks, I am in, and the back room is let, and the man is from Norwich.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the house has you at the door and him above the ceiling. The book goes back on the shelf. We have sworn.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have sworn. I will say it if I am asked, and I will not be clever.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From Norwich. I have it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Thank you. I will be quiet. A jug and a pot is a great plenty.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Quiet is the rent today. Go up. Nobody has come. If nobody comes, we do not celebrate it. We go on being a house.
